**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Brazil wildfires]]
**Forty-eight cities in [[Brazil]] issue red alerts for prolonged heavy and hazardous [[smog]] originating from extensive wildfires. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-fires-smoke-alert-amazon-794564d078bd3c9f265cc3dd429cab4e (AP)]

[https://apnews.com/article/delta-explosion-kills-two-workers-atlanta-georgia-978d4a77652375968b7000c8dee0ca7f (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2024 Red Sea oil spill]]
**[[The Pentagon]] reports that the MT ''Sounion'' appears to be leaking its 150,000 ton supply of oil into the [[Red Sea]], and is still on fire since [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] attacks on August 22. Efforts to salvage the tanker have been repelled by Houthi threats. [https://www.reuters.com/world/greek-flagged-oil-tanker-appears-be-leaking-oil-pentagon-says-2024-08-27/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Namibia]]n [[Ministry of Environment and Tourism (Namibia)|environment ministry]] announces a plan to [[cull]] 723 wild animals, including 83 elephants, and to distribute the meat to people who have been affected by a severe nationwide drought. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/namibia-cull-83-elephants-distribute-meat-people-affected-by-drought-2024-08-27/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–Mexico relations]], [[Mexico–United States relations]]
**[[Mexico]] suspends all interactions with the [[Embassy of Canada, Mexico City|Canadian]] and [[Embassy of the United States, Mexico City|American embassies]] in [[Mexico City]] due to claimed interference with its independence and internal affairs after both ambassadors criticized reform plans for members of the judiciary, up to and including [[Supreme Court of Mexico|Supreme Court justices]], to be elected by [[election|popular vote]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-pause-relationship-with-us-embassy-after-judicial-reform-comments-2024-08-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Egypt–Somalia relations]]
**Following a defense pact signed by [[Somali President]] [[Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]] and [[Egyptian President]] [[Abdel Fattah El-Sisi]] earlier this month, [[Egypt]] deploys two [[C-130]] aircraft carrying [[Egyptian military|military]] officers and equipment to [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]], as the initial phase of a significant deployment that will see up to 10,000 Egyptian soldiers stationed in Somalia. [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/egypt-deploys-military-to-somalia-in-strategic-move-amid-horn-of-africa-tensions (Garowa Online)]
*[[France–Russia relations]]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian Foreign Minister]] [[Sergey Lavrov|Sergei Lavrov]] states that bilateral relations between [[France]] and [[Russia]] have "reached a [[nadir]]" following [[Arrest of Pavel Durov|the arrest and captivity extension of]] [[Russians|Russian-born]] [[Telegram (software)|Telegram]] [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] [[Pavel Durov]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/telegram-boss-stay-french-custody-russia-alleges-us-meddling-2024-08-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Indictments against Donald Trump]]
**[[Federal prosecution of Donald Trump (election obstruction case)|Federal prosecution of Donald Trump]]
***[[United States Department of Justice|U.S. Justice Department]] [[Smith special counsel investigation|special counsel]] [[Jack Smith (lawyer)|Jack Smith]] files a superseding indictment against former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] for his attempts to [[Attempts to overturn the 2020 United States presidential election|overturn]] the [[2020 United States presidential election]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2024/08/27/trump-indicted-2020-election-subversion-00176503 (Politico)]
*[[Arrest of Pavel Durov]]
**[[France|French]] prosecutors publicly accuse [[Telegram (software)|Telegram]] [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] [[Pavel Durov]] of twelve charges including violations associated with [[drug trafficking]], [[Child sexual abuse|child exploitation]], and [[money laundering]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/telegrams-ceo-pavel-durov-faces-multiple-criminal-charges-from-paris-prosecutors/ (''Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Australian Police]] and [[New Zealand Police]] announce they have concluded a joint [[illicit drug]] operation that resulted in 1,611 arrests and 2,962 charges [[Australia|nationwide]]. The police also confiscated almost {{conv|1400|kg|lb}} of illicit drugs and over 2,500 [[cannabis]] plants, worth 93 million [[Australian dollar|AUD]] (US$63 million). [https://www.dw.com/en/australian-police-carry-out-massive-nationwide-drug-bust/a-70056881 (DW)] 
*[[Federal Police (Germany)|German police]] shoot a 26-year-old man dead in [[Moers]], [[Germany]], after the man attacked two officers with a knife. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-moers-police-shoot-suspect-knives-fc468fc99be40c5011518444f6303692 (AP)]
*[[Malaysia]] charges [[Leader of the Opposition (Malaysia)|opposition leader]] and former [[Prime Minister of Malaysia|Prime Minister]] [[Muhyiddin Yassin]] for allegedly [[Lèse-majesté|insulting]] the former [[King of Malaysia|King]] [[Abdullah of Pahang|Al-Sultan Abdullah]] in 2022, under the [[Sedition Act 1948|Sedition Act]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/malaysia-charges-ex-pm-muhyiddin-over-alleged-royal-insult/a-70056050 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 French legislative election]]
**[[France]]'s [[New Popular Front]] (NFP) party suspends future talks with [[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] to break a [[Gridlock (politics)|political deadlock]] after Macron refused to implement a [[Left-wing politics|leftist]]-led [[Coalition government|coalition government]] despite the NFP receiving the second-most votes in the legislative election, and also calls for nationwide protests against Macron's "parody of democracy". [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/frances-macron-back-square-one-talks-forming-government-drag-2024-08-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Kolkata rape and murder incident]]
**[[West Bengal Police]] fire [[tear gas]] and [[water cannon]]s at protesting university students and medical professionals demanding the resignation of [[List of chief ministers of West Bengal|West Bengal Chief Minister]] [[Mamata Banerjee]] for her handling in the rape and murder case of a [[medic]] in [[Kolkata]], [[West Bengal]], [[India]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/27/india-police-fire-tear-gas-at-protest-against-kolkata-doctors-rape-murder (Al Jazeera)]
